unit.why: A single anecdote, told by a named hasid, about the tzaddik staying awake all night in thought over a sinful visitor.

stories.start_quote: סיפר הרה״ח מו"ה משה דוד גוטמאן ז"ל
stories.end_quote: ווארפין פון כלל ישראל איז מיר זייער שווער עס איז דאך אנפש
stories.summary_en: The hasid Moshe David Gutman, who waited each night in the house of R. A"Y of S"G until dismissed, could not rouse him from his holy thoughts one night until dawn. The rebbe explained that a man had come to him that day whom he could neither bring into Klal Yisrael, because his deeds were too foul, nor cast out, because he was still a soul.
